Response JSON built DuckDB (to_json(struct_pack(...))) pasted envelope; never round-trip records jsonlite (empty arrays, nulls, int64, nesting). Group rows small go .api_json(rows, na = "null"). / stays JSON-queries; without oql/oqo redirects /app. plumber2 picks serializer Accept, httr2 (openalexPro) sends none, HTML JSON one route mislabel JSON openalexPro reject . Extra columns served . served: .api_not_served (page, citation, abstract, relevance_score) oaapi_*. abstract_inverted_index rebuilt JSONL-path corpora (round-trips exactly). Filter columns whose type differs files cast back (.api_column_types). snapshot’s abstract_inverted_index JSON string: cast MAP(VARCHAR, BIGINT[]) via JSON; records repeated keys (~0.6 %) fail cast merged .api_merge_duplicate_keys() (json_each). .api_build_version part cache key: bump whenever .api_build() (anything creates) changes, users keep stale cache. Search: two FTS tables (oaapi_docs_stem Porter + English stop words, oaapi_docs_exact none), conjunctive BM25 (OpenAlex ANDs words, checked live), phrases wildcards regex oaapi_title/oaapi_abstract; relevance_score = sum non-negated search leaves. Search terms computed per request (oqo_to_sql()$prelude, run .api_run_prelude()): BM25 query temp table oaapi_s<n>(, s), leaf oaapi_id (SELECT oaapi_s<n>), score one lookup oaapi_score. Grouped requests run filter temp tables (oaapi_m, oaapi_g); fine read-connection, requests handled one time. text: /works endpoint takes OpenAlex’s parameters: filter names OpenAlex’s, aliases included (is_oa, cites, author.id, institutions.country_code, title.search, …): OpenAlex translates . OQL OQO queries go root, OpenAlex: response carries query ran meta.x_query: OQL text (translated queries) OQO. Responses OpenAlex shape: records: {"meta": {count, page, per_page, next_cursor, …}, "results": […]}; groups: {"meta": {count, groups_count, …}, "group_by": [{key, key_display_name, count}]}; single work: record . Paging works page cursor, 200 per page. sample (without seed) every page. Errors HTTP 400 OpenAlex’s validation message queries translate. queries local corpus answer, {"error", "message"}, example filter supported . OpenAlex’s /query unreachable 503.

title: Querying a Local Corpus like OpenAlex
text: One group_by dimension per query supported, columns /corpus lists group_by. Dates, fwci, doi cited_by grouped , OpenAlex. Counting: work counts per key. List columns (countries, authors, topics, …) unpacked first. Filters search apply grouping. Keys: OpenAlex. means https://openalex.org/types/article, https://openalex.org/countries/CH, entity IDs, plain years, counts true/false. ID stored several forms one group. Sorting: count (largest first), sort=key:asc (numeric keys sort numbers), count:asc count:desc. Missing values: group_by=column:include_unknown adds works without value group unknown. Display names countries, languages licenses codes (“CH”), OpenAlex shows full name (“Switzerland”): corpus names .

title: Querying a Local Corpus like OpenAlex
text: full text locally. searches run title abstract: search rules follow OpenAlex: Words: words must match. coral bleaching finds works . Phrases: "coral bleaching" must appear order. Boolean operators: , work terms. Proximity: "coral"~3~"bleaching" finds terms 3 words , either order. classic "coral bleaching"~3 keeps order. Wildcards: bleach* works exact search . Relevance: results ranked relevance_score (BM25), record carries. default sort searching, sort=relevance_score:desc|asc works . differences OpenAlex: stemmer (Porter) folds word forms OpenAlex’s, stemmed counts can higher; exact searches closer; proximity “N words terms” (N 1000), approximation OpenAlex’s slop; chain (""~3~"b"~2~"c") pair distance; stemmed searches, phrases proximity match word stems ("coral reefs" also finds “coral reef”); affiliation author-name searches match whole words, without stemming, add nothing relevance_score. OpenAlex, unquoted words may come different affiliations work, quoted phrase must within one; searches fields corpus index (e.g. affiliation strings) 400.
